# Milestone briefs

Each file is one BetterDev milestone — backend briefs in `be/`, frontend briefs
in `fe/`. Run its check from **Actions → BetterDev check** with the id (the file
name without `.md`).

<!-- feature-map:start — generated by `node betterdev/tasks/build.mjs`; edit the briefs and features.json instead -->
## What you're building

The finished app, feature by feature, and the tasks that build each part. Each
brief's **What the app's users get** line says what that task adds for the people
using the app; *internal* tasks change nothing they see. A feature is done when
every one of its tasks passes its check.

| Feature | What its users get | Backend | Frontend |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sign-in & sessions** | Sign in, stay signed in safely, and only do what your role allows. | [be-security](be/be-security.md), [be-rate-limit](be/be-rate-limit.md) | [fe-error-boundary](fe/fe-error-boundary.md) |
| **People directory** | Find anyone in the company: search, filter by role and page through hundreds of people. | — | [fe-fetch](fe/fe-fetch.md), [fe-custom-hook](fe/fe-custom-hook.md) *(internal)*, [fe-ts-generics](fe/fe-ts-generics.md) *(internal)* |
| **Teams & members** | Create teams and manage who is in them, with clear messages when something isn't allowed. | [be-errors](be/be-errors.md) | [fe-a11y](fe/fe-a11y.md) |
| **Projects** | Create projects, choose who is on them and open each project's own pages. | [be-crud](be/be-crud.md) | [fe-component](fe/fe-component.md), [fe-form](fe/fe-form.md), [fe-routing](fe/fe-routing.md) |
| **Tasks** | Plan the work as tasks: assign, filter, sort and edit them together, with rich descriptions. | [be-api-design](be/be-api-design.md), [be-profile](be/be-profile.md), [be-idempotency](be/be-idempotency.md) | [fe-xss](fe/fe-xss.md) |
| **Activity log** | See who changed what, newest first, all the way back. | [be-service-layer](be/be-service-layer.md) | [fe-virtualization](fe/fe-virtualization.md) |
| **Dashboard** | Charts and numbers on how the work is going, always current. | [be-caching](be/be-caching.md) | [fe-code-split](fe/fe-code-split.md) |
| **CSV export** | Download a project's tasks as a spreadsheet, however many there are. | [be-jobs](be/be-jobs.md) | — |
| **Integrations** | Other tools are told when a task's status changes. | [be-webhooks](be/be-webhooks.md) | — |
| **Team chat** | Every team has a live chat room. | [be-websocket-rooms](be/be-websocket-rooms.md) | [fe-chat-room](fe/fe-chat-room.md) |
| **Video calls** | Start a video call from the team's chat room. | [be-video-signaling](be/be-video-signaling.md) | [fe-video-chat](fe/fe-video-chat.md) |
| **Language & formats** | Use the app in English or Bulgarian, with local dates and numbers. | — | [fe-i18n](fe/fe-i18n.md) |
| **Running in production** *(internal)* | Nothing users see directly: the app starts safely, and problems can be traced and measured. | [be-config](be/be-config.md) *(internal)*, [be-observability](be/be-observability.md) *(internal)* | — |
<!-- feature-map:end -->

## Backend — suggested order

| Id | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| be-security | Fix | Close the authorization holes |
| be-errors | Fix | One error format, correct status codes |
| be-config | Fix | Configuration that fails fast |
| be-crud | Build | Projects CRUD with members |
| be-api-design | Build + Fix | Tasks API: filtering, sorting, pagination |
| be-profile | Fix + Pressure | Find and fix the slow paths |
| be-idempotency | Build | Safe retries and concurrent edits |
| be-rate-limit | Build | Rate-limit login |
| be-service-layer | Build | Activity feed and analytics through a service layer |
| be-caching | Build | Cache the dashboard numbers |
| be-jobs | Build | Background CSV export |
| be-webhooks | Build | Signed outgoing webhooks |
| be-observability | Build | Request IDs, structured logs, metrics |
| be-websocket-rooms | Build | Team chat rooms over a WebSocket |
| be-video-signaling | Build | Signaling and TURN credentials for video calls |

## Frontend — suggested order

| Id | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| fe-a11y | Fix | Make the Add member dialog accessible |
| fe-fetch | Fix | Fix the data fetching |
| fe-error-boundary | Fix | Errors that recover |
| fe-custom-hook | Build | Extract reusable hooks |
| fe-ts-generics | Build | A typed, generic data table |
| fe-component | Build | Projects page from small components |
| fe-form | Build | Project form with real validation |
| fe-routing | Build | Project detail with nested routes |
| fe-xss | Build | Render task descriptions safely |
| fe-virtualization | Build | Activity log that scales |
| fe-code-split | Build | Dashboard without bloating the bundle |
| fe-i18n | Build | Dates, numbers and a second language |
| fe-chat-room | Build | Live team chat |
| fe-video-chat | Build | Video calls in the chat room |

Frontend tasks don't need a backend: `npm run dev:mock` in `frontend/` runs the
app against an in-browser mock of the whole API (`src/mocks/fakeApi.ts`, plus the
chat socket in `src/mocks/fakeRealtime.ts`), and the
frontend checks run against a mocked API too, never your backend.
